description: Portrait of O'Keeffe in a black head scarf sitting in the driver's seat of her black convertible automobile with two passengers; a man with a beard wearing a dark suit sits in the passenger seat and a young man in a white shirt sits in the jump-seat in the rear; both O'Keeffe and the man look directly at the camera with a slight smile, in the background - trees cast shadows on the house
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
